question: Which convention, ratified in 1998, seeks to protect the environment and human health by encouraging shared responsibility and cooperation in the global trade of pesticides and hazardous chemicals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rotterdam Convention**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Rotterdam Convention**, officially named the "Rotterdam Convention on the Prior Informed Consent Procedure for Certain Hazardous Chemicals and Pesticides in International Trade," was adopted in **1998**.
 
• The convention aims to promote **shared responsibility and cooperative efforts** among countries in managing the trade of hazardous chemicals and pesticides to protect human health and the environment.
 
• It establishes a **legally binding framework** for the international trade of certain hazardous chemicals, ensuring that countries have the necessary information to assess their risks and make informed decisions about their importation and use.
 
• The Rotterdam Convention operates through the **Prior Informed Consent (PIC) Procedure**, which allows countries to decide whether to allow or restrict the import of hazardous chemicals listed under the Convention.
